review_description: Nick and his team where all over it from quoting stage to the finished product. So happy with the end product. The lads ripped in and left the place spotless. Very happy with the service and not to mention the price was competitive.

I had a great experience with Organic Energy Co. The sales and quoting process was smooth and straightforward, with no pressure or confusing information. They took the time to explain the system options and answered all my questions, which made me feel confident in my decision.The installation was handled professionally. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and left the site tidy. They were polite throughout the entire process, and I appreciated how respectful they were of my property.Customer service was excellent as well. They helped with organizing the grid connection and provided clear instructions on how to use the system after installation. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the service and would highly recommend Organic Energy Co to anyone looking for a reliable solar installation company.
